author: Inside Edition
description: A Thai Buddhist monk and his adorable pack of temple dogs have become a heartwarming daily occurrence for locals who live in the Pathum Thani province. Every morning at 6 a.m., the abbot of Wat Chin Wararam, Luang Por Chamnan, and his furry crew do his alms rounds down the river. Alms-giving is when people donate money, goods, or services as an act of charity or religious devotion. Inside Edition Digital has more.
title: Thai Monk Sails With Adorable Temple Dogs Every Morning
